head.t: Boston Scientific prices $3.0bn and €4.25bn senior notes to fund its pending $14.5bn Penumbra acquisition
head.x: Boston Scientific announced on 19/11/2026 the pricing of $3.0bn of US dollar senior notes and, through American Medical Systems Europe B.V., €4.25bn of euro notes, expected to close on 1 December 2026, to finance the cash consideration for its acquisition of Penumbra, Inc.
